details: CONFIRMED by reproduction. The scan loop reads every record and, for a dead owner, runs _remove_probe (git worktree remove,
rmtree, git worktree prune: hundreds of milliseconds) and then a bare os.remove. drop_shared_record suppresses
FileNotFoundError, the loop does not. Ci.prepare() is the first call of Ci._run with no try around it, so the exception
leaves Ci.main and the gate ends exit 1 with a traceback. Reachable: 6 lanes gate at once, each gate also starts a nested
probe run whose prepare() scans the same shared folder, and a dead-owner record exists exactly in the case this change
is for (a lane removed after its gate was killed). Size: 15 minutes.

failing_case: A temporary repository with one probe worktree whose shared record names an owner folder that does not exist. Two
threads (two gates of two lanes starting at once; every gate's nested probe run scans too) call
relay_ci_probe.remove_leftover_probe(repo) together. Now: both list and read the record, both remove the probe, both call
os.remove on the record; the second raises FileNotFoundError, which escapes Ci.prepare() and ends that gate with a
traceback (a red gate that found nothing wrong). It should: the probe is removed once and both calls return normally.
fix_hint: Claim the record before cleaning: try os.remove(record) first (or os.rename it to a private name) and only the call that
succeeded removes the probe; on FileNotFoundError skip it. At the least, suppress FileNotFoundError on that os.remove
(contextlib.suppress), as drop_shared_record already does. Add the two-thread test of pass-case 1.
